faqs.question: What is the official WhatsApp Business API in Brazil, and how is it different from unofficial tools?
faqs.answer:
• The official WhatsApp Business API, also called the WhatsApp Business Platform, is Meta's solution for businesses that want to communicate with customers at scale. It supports bulk campaigns, AI chatbots, multiple agents on one number, and integrations with websites and CRM systems.
  • Unlike unofficial tools that depend on QR codes or WhatsApp Web sessions, the WhatsApp Business API uses Meta's approved messaging infrastructure for more reliable business communication.
  • And you don't need to be a developer to use it. With MSG91, Brazilian businesses can set up WhatsApp, launch campaigns, build chatbots, and manage conversations through a simple, no-code dashboard.

faqs.question: Why should Brazilian businesses choose MSG91 as their WhatsApp Business API provider?
faqs.answer:
• Powerful WhatsApp automation shouldn't require technical expertise. MSG91 makes it easy to run campaigns, build AI chatbots, and manage customer conversations from one user-friendly dashboard.
  • Brazilian businesses get WhatsApp messaging rates approximately 10% lower than Meta's standard USD list rates, along with a no-code dashboard for campaigns and chatbots.
  • MSG91 goes beyond WhatsApp. With One API, businesses can manage communication across WhatsApp, SMS, RCS, email, and voice without building separate integrations for every channel.
  • You also get AI chatbots and MSG91 Hello, a shared inbox where teams can manage customer conversations together.
  • Trusted by 30,000+ businesses globally, MSG91 helps businesses simplify communication while keeping costs under control.

faqs.question: How much does WhatsApp messaging cost in Brazil?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API pricing has two parts: messaging charges and a platform subscription. MSG91 offers messaging rates approximately 10% lower than Meta's standard USD pricing for Brazil.
  • MSG91's Brazil messaging rates are:
    • Marketing: $0.05644 per message
    • Utility: $0.00614 per message
    • Authentication: $0.00614 per message
    • Service: $0.00614 per billable message after the free allowance
  • The MSG91 Titan plan costs $7/month, with the first two months free. Messaging charges and applicable taxes are separate.
  • For example, 10,000 billable marketing messages cost $564.40 with MSG91, compared with $625 at Meta's standard USD list rate, saving $60.60 before subscription fees and taxes.
  • Actual savings depend on message volume, applicable pricing tiers, and billing arrangements.
  • Compare the MSG91 Brazil pricing plans with Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform pricing.

faqs.question: Is MSG91 a secure and trusted WhatsApp Business API provider in Brazil?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. Security and reliability are essential when managing customer communication. MSG91 is SOC 2 Type II audited, reflecting independently assessed security controls and processes for protecting business information.
  • MSG91 stores customer data for Brazilian businesses in regional data centres, supporting data protection and compliance requirements.
  • MSG91 also has 200+ reviews on G2 and is trusted by 30,000+ businesses worldwide.
  • With Meta's official WhatsApp Business Platform infrastructure, businesses can manage customer conversations, automation, and integrations through a trusted communication platform.

faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 helps Brazilian businesses run Black Friday, Natal, Dia das Mães, and other promotional campaigns without building a custom integration.
  • Upload opted-in contacts through CSV files, personalise approved templates with offers and product images, schedule messages, and monitor campaign performance.
  • Want to generate leads beyond your existing customer list? Click-to-WhatsApp Ads on Facebook and Instagram let interested buyers start a conversation directly from your advertisement. faqs.question: How can businesses in Brazil reduce WhatsApp customer support costs after Meta's October 2026 pricing changes?
faqs.answer:
• Since October 1, 2026, Meta has charged for WhatsApp service messages beyond the monthly free allowance. The first 1,000 service messages per business phone number remain free each month, while additional billable messages cost $0.00614 each with MSG91 in Brazil.
  • Utility templates sent within an active customer service window also became chargeable, subject to Meta's exceptions.
  • For businesses answering hundreds of enquiries daily, these costs can add up.
  • MSG91 Chat Window provides a more cost-effective way to continue conversations: WhatsApp → Chat Window → Hello.
  • A customer starts on WhatsApp and opens a dedicated Chat Window through a link. AI chatbots or human agents then continue helping through Hello without sending every reply via WhatsApp.
  • Messages exchanged inside Chat Window do not incur Meta's WhatsApp messaging charges. Messages sent through WhatsApp remain chargeable.
  • Follow the MSG91 Chat Window setup guide to learn how it works.

faqs.question: Can Brazilian businesses send WhatsApp OTPs, use WhatsApp Flows, and configure fallback channels?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 allows businesses in Brazil to send WhatsApp OTPs for logins, account verification, and eligible authentication workflows.
  • Authentication messages to Brazilian numbers cost $0.00614 each with MSG91, based on the rates in the existing pricing FAQ.
  • With MSG91 OTP Widget, businesses can configure verification, retries, and supported alternatives such as SMS, voice, and email when the initial OTP delivery is unsuccessful.
  • MSG91 also supports WhatsApp Flows, allowing customers to complete guided tasks such as appointment bookings, lead forms, event registrations, and feedback collection without leaving WhatsApp.
  • For other important notifications, businesses can configure supported fallback workflows using SMS, RCS, email, or voice if WhatsApp delivery fails, depending on the integration.
  • Explore the OTP Widget integration guide.

faqs.question: Which industries in Brazil benefit most from WhatsApp Business API?

  • With MSG91, teams can automate everyday communication, connect existing business tools, and manage customer conversations without building everything from scratch.
  • Some of the most relevant industries in Brazil include:
    • E-commerce and retail: Recover abandoned carts, send order updates, and automate seasonal campaigns.
    • Fintech and digital banking: Send OTPs, payment notifications, and account updates.
    • Travel and hospitality: Confirm reservations, answer guest enquiries, and share booking information.
    • Healthcare and clinics: Manage appointment reminders, scheduling enquiries, and routine administrative support.
    • Real estate: Qualify property leads, answer listing questions, and schedule visits.

Online stores can use AI chatbots, multichannel verification through WhatsApp, SMS, email, and voice, COD-to-prepaid conversion workflows, and automated order confirmation, tracking, and notifications for 12+ supported Shopify events.

  • With MSG91 Hello, support teams can manage customer conversations from a shared inbox and take over whenever human assistance is needed. Explore the MSG91 Shopify integration guide.
